name: BOB
summary: BOB, also known as 4-bromo-2,5,β-trimethoxyphenethylamine or as β-methoxy-2C-B, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine, 2C, and BOx families. It is the β-methoxy derivative of 2C-B. BOB was first synthesized by Alexander Shulgin.

pharmacology.text: BOB acts as a serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist. Its affinity (Ki) was found to be 2.0 nM and its EC50 was 0.12 nM with an Emax 63%. Its affinity was 20-fold lower than that of DOB, its activational potency was half that of DOB and its efficacy was slightly higher than that of DOB (63% and 38%, respectively). 2C-B was said to have comparable affinity as DOB.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin receptor modulator; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen
